rawFindings.title: Removal of UTF-8 BOM and CRLF escape in File.read and File.readSync
rawFindings.explanation: The changes remove the escapes for BOM character '\ufeff' and Windows style CRLF line endings '\r\n' from the File.read and File.readSync methods by eliminating calls to escapeBOM and escapeEOL functions and removing the 'escape' option. This modification breaks existing functionality where content was expected to normalize line endings and strip BOM characters.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore calls to escapeBOM and escapeEOL via an escapeContent function and reinstate the 'escape' option with default true to preserve previous behavior in read() and readSync() methods.

rawFindings.title: Removed escape handling causes loss of BOM and EOL normalization in File.read()
rawFindings.explanation: The patch removes the escapeBOM and escapeEOL calls from File.read(). Previously, if options.escape was true, the content string had its BOM escaped and Windows EOLs normalized. Now, this processing is entirely removed, altering the behavior and potentially breaking expected output where BOM and EOL normalization is required.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the escapeBOM and escapeEOL calls or re-implement equivalent escape handling for content strings in File.read() when options.escape is true.

rawFindings.title: Removed escape handling causes loss of BOM and EOL normalization in File.readSync()
rawFindings.explanation: The patch removes the escapeBOM and escapeEOL calls from File.readSync(). Previously, if options.escape was true, the content string had its BOM escaped and Windows EOLs normalized. Now, this processing is entirely removed, altering the behavior and potentially breaking expected output where BOM and EOL normalization is required.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the escapeBOM and escapeEOL calls or re-implement equivalent escape handling for content strings in File.readSync() when options.escape is true.

rawFindings.title: Removed BOM and EOL escaping in read() and readSync() methods
rawFindings.explanation: The code originally escaped BOM and Windows line endings in the file content when reading with encoding, using escapeContent function (escapeBOM and escapeEOL). This behavior was removed, so files containing BOM or Windows EOL characters will no longer have those cleaned up as before, changing the returned content and potentially breaking expected output.
rawFindings.suggestion: Reintroduce the escaping of BOM and EOL in read() and readSync() methods when options.escape is true, or at least preserve the original escaping behavior to maintain backward compatibility.
